description: This file defines types, interfaces, classes, and imports related to a component-based architecture for a language model application, including memory management, message handling, node configurations, and streaming events.

classes.name: PromptTemplate
classes.description: Extends Langchain's PromptTemplate to include promptValues property.

classes.name: PromptRetriever
classes.description: Class for creating prompt retrievers with a fixed template appended to system messages.

classes.name: VectorStoreRetriever
classes.description: Class for retrieving data from a vector store with associated metadata.

classes.name: FlowiseMemory
classes.description: Abstract class extending BufferMemory, implementing MemoryMethods for chat memory management.

classes.name: FlowiseWindowMemory
classes.description: Abstract class extending BufferWindowMemory, implementing MemoryMethods for windowed chat memory.

classes.name: FlowiseSummaryMemory
classes.description: Abstract class extending ConversationSummaryMemory, implementing MemoryMethods for summarized chat memory.

classes.name: FlowiseSummaryBufferMemory
classes.description: Abstract class extending ConversationSummaryBufferMemory, implementing MemoryMethods for buffered summarized memory.

classes.name: IVisionChatModal
classes.description: Interface for vision chat modal configurations and methods.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve chat messages, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Abstract method to add chat messages, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Abstract method to clear chat messages, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: setVisionModel
methods.description: Method to set the vision model.

methods.name: revertToOriginalModel
methods.description: Method to revert to the original vision model.

calls: import { BufferMemory, BufferWindowMemory, ConversationSummaryMemory, ConversationSummaryBufferMemory } from 'langchain/memory'
import { PromptTemplate as LangchainPromptTemplate, PromptTemplateInput } from '@langchain/core/prompts'
